inlines.v: PAR'ADOX, noun [Gr. beyond, and opinion; to or suppose.] A tenet or proposition contrary to received opinion, or seemingly absurd, yet true in fact. A gloss there is to color that paradox and make it appear in show not to be altogether unreasonable.
